task: 8. Implement TPM2-first keys with explicit secure fallback status
method: cargo test -p namtor-store --lib + cargo test -p namtor-daemon --lib manager:: + cargo clippy -p namtor-store -p namtor-daemon -- -D warnings

protection_kinds.description: TPM2 2.0 hardware-bound sealing via tpm2-tools CLI (feature-gated tpm2). Device-bound, non-migratable. PCR binding opt-in.
protection_kinds.auto_selected_when: /dev/tpmrm0 present and tpm2 feature enabled and tpm2_pcrread probe succeeds

protection_kinds.description: AES-256-GCM with root/namtor-owned 0600 key file. Always available fallback.
protection_kinds.auto_selected_when: TPM2 unavailable (no /dev/tpmrm0, feature off, or probe failed)

tests.name: protection_state_tpm2_has_no_warning
tests.asserts: TPM2-sealed key produces ProtectionState with empty warning

tests.name: protection_state_software_has_visible_warning
tests.asserts: Software fallback key produces non-empty warning string

tests.name: protection_state_contains_no_key_material
tests.asserts: ProtectionState debug output contains no raw key bytes (hex) or key path

tests.name: fallback_key_file_is_0600
tests.asserts: Software fallback key file mode is exactly 0600

tests.name: mock_seal_unseal_round_trip
tests.asserts: TPM2-type backend seal->unseal roundtrip recovers the original key

tests.name: mock_pcr_seal_unseal_round_trip
tests.asserts: PCR-bound seal->unseal roundtrip succeeds with matching PCR state

tests.name: pcr_mismatch_denied_after_reboot
tests.asserts: PCR mismatch after reboot is denied with Tpm2 error containing 'PCR policy mismatch'

tests.name: template_store_protection_status_software_fallback
tests.asserts: TemplateProfileStore.protection_status() maps KeySource::File to ProtectionKeyKind::Software with non-empty warning

tests.name: null_store_protection_status_reports_no_store
tests.asserts: NullProfileStore.protection_status() returns Software with 'no store loaded' warning

tests.name: protection_status_contains_no_key_material
tests.asserts: ProtectionStatus debug output contains no store path or /var/lib/namtor path

status_contract.store_type: ProtectionState { sealing: KeySource, has_tpm: bool, warning: String }
status_contract.contract_type: ProtectionStatus { sealing: ProtectionKeyKind, has_tpm: bool, warning: String }
status_contract.exposed_via: ManagerService::protection_status() (v2 GetProtectionStatus method, Task 9/17 wires bus interface)
